readings.Aries: Rest is not retreat. Your system needs to cycle before it can perform at capacity again. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Taurus: Your relationship with pleasure is complicated in a way that has nothing to do with pleasure. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Gemini: The restlessness you feel is signal, not noise. What is it pointing at? You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Cancer: The person you've been nurturing needs you to need them back. Allow it. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Leo: Your loyalty is total and it's not being matched. This is worth acknowledging. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Virgo: You have spent considerable energy on a detail that no longer matters. Redirect. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Libra: The relationship that looks perfect from the outside is not being perceived from the inside. Which is true? This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Scorpio: Something is ending that you don't want to end. Your resistance is understandable and will not stop it. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Sagittarius: The adventure you need does not require travel. Change the frame of what's in front of you. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: The version of yourself that needed to prove something — what were you proving, and to whom? The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Aquarius: Something that started as an experiment has become something you actually need. Admit the need. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Pisces: You've been generous with your understanding of others. Apply some to yourself. The timing is better than it feels.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
